scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/core -w packages/themes && npm run build -w packages/adapters -w packages/presets -w packages/react -w packages/create-flowkit && npm run build -w apps/playground --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run verify:fast && npm run test:e2e
scripts.verify:fast: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && node scripts/spec-check.mjs
scripts.release: npm run build -w packages/core -w packages/themes && npm run build -w packages/adapters -w packages/presets -w packages/react -w packages/create-flowkit && npm publish -w packages/core -w packages/themes -w packages/adapters -w packages/presets -w packages/react -w packages/create-flowkit
